title: What are your thoughts on Kubrick's The Killing (1956)?

commenti.body: That's a hot take.  I enjoyed the hell out of it.  It seems like you may be more technical in your viewing than I am, but I thought it was a very tight hour and 25 minutes.  It was also fun to see the clown masks and realizing the dark knight heist scene is an homage
OP is probably trolling or has no clue what he’s talking about. But I’m pretty sure it’s a bait post. The Quentin Tarantino comparison gives it away to me, at least lol.
Yeah... weird... i mostly do not enjoy most of Kubrick movies but that was weird.

It's genuinely been about 20 years since I've seen it so I'm just going off memory here. But I loved it. I love a good heist anyway but this one was really well done. And I got the sense that Kubrick was probably more shackled making this movie than he would be later in his career (later he'd have the freedom to shoot hundreds of takes etc.). I don't think that's a bad thing - restrictions make for good filmmaking.

But yes, it has been a while. I'll need to rewatch it again soon.

This might be a troll post, but imo Its an Ok/decent movie that rightfully doesn't get as recognition or praise as his other films, bc it is not nearly as good.
